source:
name: rtd-sphinx-build

# REUSABLE WORKFLOW — org-level pilot (scitex-stats, 2026-07-10).
# Mechanically extracted from the `docs-sphinx` job in
# scitex-ai/scitex-stats `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (this is a local
# `sphinx-build` smoke check, not a ReadTheDocs.org webhook trigger — RTD
# itself builds independently from its own webhook).
#
# 2026-07-22 — GREEN NO-OP FIX. The original probed only docs/conf.py,
# docs/source/conf.py and docs/src/conf.py, and `exit 0`d when it found
# none. Measured across the org that day: 66 of 74 repos keep conf.py at
# `docs/sphinx/conf.py` and ZERO repos use ANY of the three probed paths —
# so in every one of the 15 repos already calling this reusable the gate
# matched nothing and exited 0. Fifteen repos were passing green while
# building no documentation at all, and the `exit 0` made that
# indistinguishable from a real build.
#
# Two changes close it:
#   1. `docs_dir` is now an INPUT (default `docs/sphinx`, the org
#      convention). The zero-input design of these reusables is the
#      documented root cause of the rtd-sphinx variant sprawl — a repo that
#      keeps conf.py elsewhere overrides the input instead of forking the
#      workflow.
#   2. A missing conf.py is now a HARD FAILURE by default. `required: false`
#      is the explicit, auditable opt-out for repos that genuinely ship no
#      docs — and it says so LOUDLY in the log rather than looking like a
#      pass. A gate that cannot fail is not a gate.

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# BEFORE CONVERTING A LEAF TO CALL THIS: ENUMERATE WHICH OF THE LEAF'S
# PUBLISHED CHECK CONTEXTS ARE REQUIRED BY BRANCH PROTECTION, ON EVERY
# PROTECTED BRANCH.
#
#     gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/branches/{branch}/protection
#
# Calling a reusable renames the context from `<job>` to
# `<caller-job> / <callee-job>`, and the separator is STRUCTURAL — no caller
# configuration can preserve a bare context, and the callee's job `name:` is
# fixed here. Protection then waits forever on a check nothing will publish.
# NO PR CAN FIX THAT; only an admin protection edit can.
#
# THIS CANNOT BE DETERMINED FROM THE WORKFLOW FILES. Measured 2026-08-18:
# `audit` is REQUIRED on figrecipe and NOT required on scitex-app, from files
# that look identical. Four repos checked; three share one protection set and
# the fourth differs on both branches AND between its own two branches — so it
# cannot be assumed from a sibling repo either.
#
# The safe order: add the caller ALONGSIDE the legacy workflow; read the check
# names GitHub actually publishes from a throwaway PR; move the required
# contexts while BOTH sets publish; only then delete the legacy file. At no
# point is a required context unpublished.
#
# AND FOR THIS WORKFLOW SPECIFICALLY: it is BUILD-ONLY. Leaves that also vendor
# the built HTML into `src/<pkg>/_sphinx_html` and commit it back are publishing
# documentation that SHIPS INSIDE THE WHEEL. Converting such a leaf to a bare
# `uses:` freezes that bundle with CI green and nothing saying so — see
# `upload_artifact`, which exists so the caller keeps the publish half.
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      dev_original_commands:
        description: Run the full original scitex-dev validation and develop-only docs refresh.
        type: boolean
        required: false
        default: false
      runs_on:
        description: >-
          Runner label set for this job, as a JSON ARRAY STRING (it is consumed
          by fromJSON). DEFAULTS TO GITHUB-HOSTED, because a default must FAIL
          SAFE. It defaulted to the Spartan pool until 2026-08-15, when all
          four `spartan-cpu` runners went offline and every caller that passes
          nothing -- which was every caller, since no shipped stub passes this
          input -- silently requested a label no online machine served: 57
          queued runs across ~30 repositories, while the repo-level CI_RUNS_ON
          variables set on 76 of 76 repos had no effect at all, because THIS
          input selects the runner and nothing was passing it. A hosted default
          degrades to SLOWER; a self-hosted default degrades to NEVER. Pass
          `runs_on` to prefer our own hardware -- Spartan stays PREFERRED where
          it is faster (operator, 2026-08-13); this line only decides what
          happens when a caller is silent.
          MUST be a JSON string, not a YAML list: a YAML list decodes to
          something fromJSON rejects, and the resulting label mismatch makes
          the job QUEUE FOREVER rather than fail, which is indistinguishable
          from "still waiting" in the run list.
        type: string
        required: false
        default: '["ubuntu-latest"]'
      docs_dir:
        description: >-
          Directory holding the sphinx conf.py. Defaults to the org
          convention `docs/sphinx`. The legacy layouts (docs, docs/source,
          docs/src) are still probed as fallbacks, so setting this is only
          necessary for a genuinely unusual layout
          (e.g. `docs/sphinx/source`).
        type: string
        required: false
        default: docs/sphinx
      required:
        description: >-
          When true (the default), a missing conf.py FAILS the job. Set to
          false only for repos that genuinely ship no sphinx docs — the skip
          is then reported loudly instead of silently passing.
        type: boolean
        required: false
        default: true
      dependency_group:
        description: >-
          PEP 735 dependency-group holding the docs requirements, installed
          with `uv pip install --group`. Leave empty (the default) to keep the
          `.[docs]` EXTRA path.
          REQUIRED FOR ADOPTION BY PEP 735 REPOS, not a convenience. Measured
          on scitex-ai/scitex-app 2026-08-18: it declares docs under
          `[dependency-groups]`, so `-e ".[docs]"` matches nothing and the job
          died at `sphinx-build: No such file or directory`, exit 127 —
          `rtd-sphinx-build / docs-sphinx` FAILURE beside its own legacy
          `sphinx` SUCCESS in the same run. The `||` fallback chain below does
          NOT catch it: uv treats an unknown extra as a WARNING and exits 0, so
          nothing downstream ever fires. Any repo on the modern packaging
          spelling inherits this.
        type: string
        required: false
        default: ''
      python_version:
        description: >-
          Interpreter for the docs venv. Default 3.12 preserves today's
          behaviour. Callers whose `.readthedocs.yaml` pins a different
          `build.tools.python` should pass the SAME value here, so the CI
          smoke build and the RTD build use one interpreter — otherwise this
          gate is green against a Python the published docs are never built
          with.
        type: string
        required: false
        default: '3.12'
      fail_on_warning:
        description: >-
          Pass `-W` to sphinx-build, turning warnings into errors. Default
          false preserves today's behaviour. Leaves that run `-W` on
          pull_request CANNOT convert to this reusable without it: doing so
          silently WEAKENS their docs gate, which is the direction nobody
          re-checks.
        type: boolean
        required: false
        default: false
      upload_artifact:
        description: >-
          Upload the built HTML as an artifact so the CALLER can vendor and
          commit it in its own follow-on job.
          This exists because the reusable is BUILD-ONLY while ~30 leaves are
          BUILD + PUBLISH: they copy `docs/sphinx/_build/html` into
          `src/<pkg>/_sphinx_html` and commit it back. That bundle is NOT a
          build artifact — hatch packages `src/<pkg>` wholesale, so it SHIPS
          INSIDE THE WHEEL, and a leaf converted to a bare `uses:` today would
          silently FREEZE its users' documentation while CI stayed green.
          Deliberately an ARTIFACT rather than a `commit_back` input: the
          reusable publisher opens or updates a PR against the caller's
          pushed branch instead of pushing directly to a protected branch.
          This keeps the generated bundle reviewable and avoids a second build.
        type: boolean
        required: false
        default: false
      artifact_name:
        description: Name for the uploaded HTML artifact (see upload_artifact).
        type: string
        required: false
        default: sphinx-html
      bundle_dir:
        description: >-
          Optional repository-relative destination for the built HTML bundle.
          On push events, a GitHub-hosted publish job copies the artifact there
          and opens or updates a PR to the pushed branch. Pull requests only build.
        type: string
        required: false
        default: ''
    outputs:
      html_dir:
        description: >-
          Repo-relative directory holding the built HTML, for a caller that
          downloads the artifact and needs to know where it came from.
        value: ${{ jobs.docs-sphinx.outputs.html_dir }}

jobs:
  runner-admission:
    uses: ./.github/workflows/runner-admission.yml
    with:
      runs_on: ${{ inputs.runs_on }}

  docs-sphinx:
    if: ${{ !inputs.dev_original_commands }}
    needs: [runner-admission]
    name: docs-sphinx
    # FORK-AUTHORED PRs ARE ROUTED TO ubuntu-latest HERE, UNCONDITIONALLY —
    # never to `inputs.runs_on`, which may be self-hosted. Same fork
    # predicate as the guard step below on purpose: one sanctioned answer to
    # "is this a fork?", not two that can drift apart. Non-fork runs are
    # additionally require the shared original-actor/member admission. The guard is the
    # BACKSTOP: it independently checks `runner.environment` and refuses
    # checkout if this expression is ever wrong. See README.md "Fork guard"
    # and tests/test_fork_guard.py.
    runs-on: >-
      ${{ (github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name != github.repository)
          && fromJSON('["ubuntu-latest"]')
          || fromJSON(needs.runner-admission.outputs.runs_on) }}
    timeout-minutes: 15
    outputs:
      html_dir: ${{ steps.build.outputs.html_dir }}
    steps:
      # FORK GUARD — MUST BE THE FIRST STEP, AHEAD OF actions/checkout, which is
      # what first puts fork-authored content on the node. `runs-on` above
      # already routes a fork-authored PR to ubuntu-latest, so this is now a
      # BACKSTOP: it only fires if a fork PR somehow still landed on a
      # self-hosted runner (a caller override, a future edit to `runs-on`).
      # Rationale and what this deliberately does NOT stop: README.md "Fork
      # guard". Ordering and predicate are asserted in tests/test_fork_guard.py
      # — do not reorder, do not reword the `if` without updating _GUARD_IF
      # there.
      #
      # Sphinx makes the exposure concrete: `conf.py` is arbitrary Python that
      # the build EXECUTES, so a fork PR touching docs/ runs its own code here
      # without needing a build-backend hook at all — which is exactly why the
      # backstop above still matters even with routing in place.
      - name: Refuse to run fork-authored code on self-hosted infrastructure
        if: >-
          github.event_name == 'pull_request' &&
          github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name != github.repository &&
          runner.environment == 'self-hosted'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          echo "::error title=Fork PR blocked::Fork-authored code is not run on the self-hosted Spartan pool."
          echo "head repo: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name }}  base repo: ${{ github.repository }}"
          echo "To review this contribution, adopt its branch into ${{ github.repository }} and open a same-repo PR:"
          echo "  gh pr checkout ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }} && git push origin HEAD:review/pr-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}"
          exit 1
      - name: Require confirmed organization membership on native runners
        if: runner.environment == 'self-hosted' && needs.runner-admission.outputs.native_authorized != 'true'
        run: |
          echo '::error::Organization membership admission was not confirmed.'
          exit 1
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v7
        with:
          cache-dependency-glob: pyproject.toml
      - name: Build sphinx HTML (satisfies PS-122; RTD bundle stays fresh)
        id: build
        env:
          DOCS_DIR: ${{ inputs.docs_dir }}
          DOCS_REQUIRED: ${{ inputs.required }}
          DOCS_GROUP: ${{ inputs.dependency_group }}
          PY_VERSION: ${{ inputs.python_version }}
          FAIL_ON_WARNING: ${{ inputs.fail_on_warning }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # The caller's docs_dir is probed FIRST, then the legacy layouts.
          CANDIDATES="$DOCS_DIR/conf.py docs/sphinx/conf.py docs/conf.py docs/source/conf.py docs/src/conf.py"
          CONF=""
          for c in $CANDIDATES; do
            [ -f "$c" ] && CONF="$c" && break
          done
          if [ -z "$CONF" ]; then
            # A skip must NEVER be reported as a pass. Either this repo
            # declared it ships no docs, or the gate just failed to find the
            # docs it was pointed at — those are different outcomes and they
            # get different exit codes.
            echo "::error::no sphinx conf.py found. Searched, in order:"
            for c in $CANDIDATES; do echo "::error::  $c"; done
            if [ "$DOCS_REQUIRED" = "false" ]; then
              echo "::warning::SKIPPING the sphinx build — this caller passes \`required: false\`, so NO DOCUMENTATION WAS BUILT and this job's green does NOT mean the docs compile."
              exit 0
            fi
            echo "::error::To point the gate at your docs, pass the directory holding conf.py:"
            echo "::error::    uses: scitex-ai/.github/.github/workflows/rtd-sphinx-build.yml@main"
            echo "::error::    with:"
            echo "::error::      docs_dir: path/to/your/docs"
            echo "::error::If this repo genuinely ships no sphinx docs, opt out explicitly:"
            echo "::error::    uses: scitex-ai/.github/.github/workflows/rtd-sphinx-build.yml@main"
            echo "::error::    with:"
            echo "::error::      required: false"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "found sphinx conf.py at $CONF"
          uv venv --python "$PY_VERSION" .venv
          if [ -n "$DOCS_GROUP" ]; then
            # PEP 735 dependency group. No `||` chain: the caller named this
            # group explicitly, so a failure here is a real defect in the
            # caller's pyproject and must be reported as one, not papered over.
            uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e . --group "$DOCS_GROUP"
          else
            uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e ".[docs]" \
              || uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e ".[all,dev]" \
              || { uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e .; uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python sphinx; }
          fi
          # THE FALLBACK CHAIN ABOVE CANNOT BE TRUSTED TO HAVE WORKED, and this
          # check is why the `dependency_group` input alone is not the whole
          # fix. `uv pip install -e ".[docs]"` against a package with no `docs`
          # EXTRA emits `warning: The package `<pkg>` does not have an extra
          # named `docs`` and EXITS 0 — so `||` never fires, nothing installs
          # sphinx, and the failure surfaces three lines later as a bare
          # `No such file or directory` naming a path instead of a cause.
          # Measured on scitex-ai/scitex-app 2026-08-18 (exit 127).
          if [ ! -x .venv/bin/sphinx-build ]; then
            echo "::error title=sphinx not installed::the docs dependencies did not install sphinx, so there is nothing to build with."
            echo "::error::Checked for .venv/bin/sphinx-build after installing, and it is absent."
            if [ -n "$DOCS_GROUP" ]; then
              echo "::error::Installed with --group '$DOCS_GROUP'. Does that group list sphinx?"
            else
              echo "::error::Installed via the '.[docs]' extra path. If this repo declares docs as a PEP 735"
              echo "::error::dependency GROUP rather than an extra, uv treats the missing extra as a WARNING"
              echo "::error::and exits 0 — pass the group instead:"
              echo "::error::    uses: scitex-ai/.github/.github/workflows/rtd-sphinx-build.yml@main"
              echo "::error::    with:"
              echo "::error::      dependency_group: docs"
            fi
            exit 1
          fi
          CONFDIR=$(dirname "$CONF")
          SPHINX_OPTS=""
          if [ "$FAIL_ON_WARNING" = "true" ]; then
            SPHINX_OPTS="-W"
            echo "fail_on_warning: sphinx warnings are errors for this build"
          fi
          # use the `sphinx-build` console script (not `python -m sphinx`) so the
          # auditor's PS-122 detects this workflow runs sphinx-build.
          .venv/bin/sphinx-build $SPHINX_OPTS -b html "$CONFDIR" "$CONFDIR/_build/html"
          echo "html_dir=$CONFDIR/_build/html" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      # The caller's bundle is uploaded once, then the publisher opens a PR.
      - name: Upload built HTML for the caller to publish
        if: ${{ (inputs.upload_artifact || inputs.bundle_dir != '') && steps.build.outputs.html_dir != '' }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ${{ inputs.artifact_name }}
          path: ${{ steps.build.outputs.html_dir }}
          if-no-files-found: error

  publish-sphinx-bundle:
    if: ${{ inputs.bundle_dir != '' && github.event_name == 'push' }}
    needs: [docs-sphinx]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ${{ inputs.artifact_name }}
          path: .rtd-sphinx-html
      - name: Validate destination and refresh the bundled HTML
        env:
          BUNDLE_DIR: ${{ inputs.bundle_dir }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          case "$BUNDLE_DIR" in
            ""|/*|..|../*|*/../*|*/..)
              echo "::error::bundle_dir must be a safe repository-relative path"
              exit 1
              ;;
          esac
          test -d .rtd-sphinx-html
          rm -rf -- "$BUNDLE_DIR"
          mkdir -p -- "$BUNDLE_DIR"
          cp -a .rtd-sphinx-html/. "$BUNDLE_DIR/"
          rm -rf -- "$BUNDLE_DIR/.doctrees"
          touch "$BUNDLE_DIR/.nojekyll"
      - name: Open or update a PR for the refreshed bundle
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@22a9089034f40e5a961c8808d113e2c98fb63676 # v7
        with:
          branch: ci/sphinx-bundle/${{ github.ref_name }}
          base: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          add-paths: ${{ inputs.bundle_dir }}
          commit-message: "docs(sphinx_html): refresh from CI build"
          title: "docs: refresh generated Sphinx bundle"
          body: "Updates the checked-in Sphinx HTML bundle from the successful centralized docs build."
          delete-branch: true

  dev-original-sphinx:
    name: sphinx
    needs: runner-admission
    # Skip when HEAD is the bot's own previous docs auto-commit — breaks
    # the infinite loop without using `[skip ci]`, which would also
    # suppress the tag-push and release workflows when the auto-commit
    # is the most recent commit on develop at release time.
    if: "inputs.dev_original_commands && (!contains(github.event.head_commit.message, 'docs(sphinx_html): refresh from CI build'))"
    runs-on: >-
      ${{ (github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name != github.repository)
          && fromJSON('["ubuntu-latest"]')
          || fromJSON(needs.runner-admission.outputs.runs_on) }}
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - name: Require company admission before native work
        env:
          RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT: ${{ runner.environment }}
          NATIVE_AUTHORIZED: ${{ needs.runner-admission.outputs.native_authorized }}
          ADMISSION_REASON: ${{ needs.runner-admission.outputs.reason }}
          ADMISSION_RUNS_ON: ${{ needs.runner-admission.outputs.runs_on }}
        run: |
          set -eu
          case "$RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT" in
            self-hosted)
              test "$NATIVE_AUTHORIZED" = true
              test "$ADMISSION_REASON" = trusted-actor
              test "$ADMISSION_RUNS_ON" = '{"group":"Organization","labels":["self-hosted","Linux","X64","scitex-org-cpu"]}'
              ;;
            github-hosted)
              # Unconfirmed or external membership runs the full original checks.
              ;;
            *)
              printf '%s\n' 'Unknown runner environment refused' >&2
              exit 1
              ;;
          esac

      - name: Refuse to run fork-authored code on self-hosted infrastructure
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name != github.repository && runner.environment
          == 'self-hosted'
        run: 'set -euo pipefail

          echo "::error title=Fork PR blocked::Fork-authored code is not run on the self-hosted Spartan pool."

          echo "head repo: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name }}  base repo: ${{ github.repository }}"

          echo "To review this contribution, adopt its branch into ${{ github.repository }} and open a same-repo PR:"

          echo "  gh pr checkout ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }} && git push origin HEAD:review/pr-${{ github.event.pull_request.number
          }}"

          exit 1

          '

      - name: Require confirmed organization membership on native runners
        if: runner.environment == 'self-hosted' && needs.runner-admission.outputs.native_authorized != 'true'
        run: 'echo ''::error::Organization membership admission was not confirmed.''

          exit 1

          '

      - name: Require the original Dev caller
        env:
          CALLER_REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
        run: test "$CALLER_REPOSITORY" = scitex-ai/scitex-dev

      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Use a job-owned Python tool cache
        run: |
          tool_cache="$RUNNER_TEMP/scitex-dev-docs-python-tools-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT}"
          scitex_state="$RUNNER_TEMP/scitex-dev-docs-state-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT}"
          mkdir -p "$tool_cache" "$scitex_state"
          printf '%s\n' "RUNNER_TOOL_CACHE=$tool_cache" \
            "AGENT_TOOLSDIRECTORY=$tool_cache" \
            "SCITEX_DIR=$scitex_state" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"

      - name: Create per-job venv (self-hosted shared-cache isolation)
        # Keep package dependencies separate from the owned base interpreter.
        # GITHUB_PATH makes discovery use the job venv; explicit interpreter
        # paths below keep install and Sphinx independent of later PATH edits.
        run: |
          python -m venv "$RUNNER_TEMP/venv"
          echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/venv/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

      - name: Install package + docs deps
        run: '"$RUNNER_TEMP/venv/bin/python" -m pip install -e ".[docs]"'

      - name: Build Sphinx HTML (warnings fail PRs only)
        run: |
          if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" = "pull_request" ]; then
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/venv/bin/python" -m sphinx -W -b html docs/sphinx docs/sphinx/_build/html
          else
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/venv/bin/python" -m sphinx -b html docs/sphinx docs/sphinx/_build/html
          fi

      - name: Refresh src/scitex_dev/_sphinx_html/ (develop push only)
        # main is PR-only — its _sphinx_html/ bundle arrives via the
        # develop -> main PR. Direct bot-pushes to main are inhibited
        # so the branch history stays linear-via-PR.
        if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/develop'
        run: |
          rm -rf src/scitex_dev/_sphinx_html
          cp -rf docs/sphinx/_build/html src/scitex_dev/_sphinx_html
          touch src/scitex_dev/_sphinx_html/.nojekyll

      - name: Commit refreshed HTML if it changed (develop push only)
        continue-on-error: true
        if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/develop'
        run: |
          if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain src/scitex_dev/_sphinx_html)" ]; then
            git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
            git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
            git add src/scitex_dev/_sphinx_html
            git commit -m "docs(sphinx_html): refresh from CI build"
            git push
          fi
